title: Fix retention policy deletion-limit stop propagation
summary: The retention policy deletion limit now stops further policy processing correctly by propagating the stop flag through the temporary setup record after each policy runs, preventing additional limit events after the batch should have ended.
key_points: The `EndCurrentRun` flag is now transported through the temporary retention policy setup record instead of being lost during isolated codeunit execution
The outer loop can now check the stop condition after each policy completes instead of continuing blindly
Per-policy error isolation is preserved while allowing proper batch termination
Added regression test cases covering limit boundary conditions and multiple runs
No changes to event signatures, scheduling, or the deletion allowance configuration
quote: Return the stop flag through the temporary retention policy setup record alongside the deletion count
